The Learning Objectives of this course are as follows:
To develop the students' ability to deal with numerical and quantitative issues in industries.

To have a proper understanding of Statistical applications in different fields.

The Learning Outcomes of this course are as follows:

Descriptive statistics: Graphical and Tabular representation of data. Measures of
